families.description: Credit to the demo bank account (salary, refunds). SYNTHETIC FORMAT, DEMO ONLY. No real Kenyan bank alert exists in corpus/ (corpus/banks/MISSING-FAMILIES.md), so this pack invents nothing about any real bank: it describes the fictional 'Hesabu Demo Bank' whose sender id HESABUDEMO no real institution uses. It exists so that the demo inbox (corpus/demo) can show a salary credit and a bank-to-M-PESA transfer pair. Load it only in demo mode; replace it with real bank packs when real alerts arrive. Decision recorded in docs/DECISIONS-NEEDED.md.
families.pattern: ^HESABU DEMO BANK: Your account (?<account_ref>[\dX*]{3,12}) has been credited with KES\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) from (?<counterparty_name>.+?) on (?<occurred_at>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2}\s+at\s+\d{2}:\d{2})\. Available balance KES\s?(?<balance_after>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\. Ref (?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{6,14})\.

examples.body: HESABU DEMO BANK: Your account XXX456 has been credited with KES 85,000.00 from ACME LOGISTICS LTD SALARY on 30/01/26 at 09:12. Available balance KES 91,234.50. Ref DB00001234.

families.pattern: ^HESABU DEMO BANK: Your account (?<account_ref>[\dX*]{3,12}) has been debited with KES\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) to M-PESA (?<counterparty_ref>(?:\+?254|0)[\dX*]{9}) on (?<occurred_at>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2}\s+at\s+\d{2}:\d{2})\. Fee KES\s?(?<fee>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\. Available balance KES\s?(?<balance_after>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\. Ref (?<external_ref>[A-Z0-9]{6,14})\.

examples.body: HESABU DEMO BANK: Your account XXX456 has been debited with KES 30,000.00 to M-PESA 0722000123 on 30/01/26 at 09:20. Fee KES 50.00. Available balance KES 61,184.50. Ref DB00001235.
